rationale: Temporary comment-out hotfix (4 files) matching the team's request: the GitLab OAuth CREDENTIAL_UI_MAPPING entry and its import are commented out (removing gitlaboauth from the type dropdown), and the Jira/Confluence 'Use OAuth 2.0 sign-in' toggle JSX + its supporting consts (oauthVariantType/isOAuthVariantSelected/showOAuthToggle/handleOAuthToggle) + the now-orphaned OAUTH_VARIANT_BY_BASE_TYPE import are commented out. baseCredentialType (used by the type select) is kept. Every site carries an EPMCDME-14586 marker and 'do not delete' note for easy revert. No orphaned symbols (typecheck clean). The pre-existing gitlaboauth save test is describe.skip'd (kept, marked) since its functionality is intentionally hidden. jiraoauth/confluenceoauth config entries and token flows are untouched; OAuthTestAction/connect hooks key off the credential-type string, not these config entries, so they are dead-but-not-broken. Covered by tests: gitlaboauth absent from CREDENTIAL_UI_MAPPING/getAvailableCredentialsTypes, and the toggle not rendered in SettingsForm. Reviewed inline, proportionate to a reversible comment-out.
